## findings
1. SOURCE-POLICY RED — F3 (XF 5). Symptom: P6 admits 7 and 0. Root cause: P6 keeps "bins are still filled in bin label order until the next bin would exceed it" in its replaced_by and does not retire base vmi_evt_replenishment "Every bin at or below its min level at a visit or self-scan is filled to its max level", while its own rule fills "the lesser of the bin's fill-to level and the whole units the allowance left buys". Evidence: vmi.extended.yaml P6 overwrite.replaced_by and rule; base vmi.yaml vmi_evt_replenishment S3; seed vmi_activity rows at VV-446198 (C-02-01 2,370.00, F-11-04 4,494.00, M-03-09 2,771.00), VWD-447031 6,270.00; tier cap 10,000.00. Consequence: reading A 7 units (GT), reading B 0 units (filling stops before R-07-02). Affected: P6 overwrite/rule; tasks/1.json evaluation_criteria step 16 quantity, design_rationale "no second reading". New.
2. SOURCE-FACTOR RED — F1/F2 on P5 replenish_gap. Symptom: tiers "0 days", "7 days", "30 / scheduled visits"; the 7-day tier ("tier schedules no visits") cannot be reached after a par-review consignment withdrawal. Consequence: P5 has no method factor and the ladder has 2 reachable tiers. Affected: P5 factors and the rule's replenishment-gap sentence. New.
3. SOURCE-FACTOR RED — F4 (XF 2). Symptom: fill_price_basis, hold_share and conversion_release are read only by `capped_units`, used only on hold_service's capped tier. Demonstration: with hold_service at its baseline (whole fill-to), substituting 152.15 / 1 / 0 for those three leaves the result 15 in every case. Affected: P6 compute (`fill_units`), factors. New.
4. SOURCE-POLICY RED — F7. submit_critical_bin_request_f65e9169 docstring "carries a reorder point of 0 that stays at 0 until Corbett records the bin's conversion entry" names the P5 write with an ordering word. New.
5. SOURCE-POLICY RED — F8 (XF 8). book_converted_bin_fill_19b3cec5 docstring "joins the visit's replenishment for billing on the visit's invoice"; body writes no billing row. New.
6. Observations: O1 (5 bins on an Onsite Storeroom; the three critical deliveries at VV-446198 have no price lines and no vmi_replenishment_billed row), O2 (closure calls the 2025-11-03 entry "Corbett's", but nothing in vmi_bins records who requested it), O3, O5, O6, O7. F5/F6 members not reached on this world.
